title: Austin Railroad Crossing Permissions 1882
summary:
• **Railroad Expansion Approved**: The council granted the International & Great Northern Railroad permission to cross Congress Avenue, with the requirement that the railroad maintain the crossing in good repair.

• **Special Committee Formed**: A committee of three aldermen, plus the Mayor and City Attorney, was appointed to oversee the railroad crossing agreement and ensure compliance.

• **Attendance Enforcement**: Three aldermen were each fined $1 for missing the meeting, showing the council took attendance seriously.
